candidate.answerReason: Evaluating the nested absolute values from the inside outward yields 2016 before the final subtraction of x, giving 4032 and choice D.

methods.label: Evaluate from the inside outward
methods.explanation:
Start with the innermost absolute value. Because \(x=-2016\), we have \(|x|=2016\), and therefore
\[
\bigl||x|-x\bigr|
=|2016-(-2016)|=4032.
\]
Now use this result in the outer absolute value, remembering that the final \(-x\) lies outside it:
\[
\left|\bigl||x|-x\bigr|-|x|\right|-x
=|4032-2016|-(-2016)
=2016+2016=4032.
\]
The value is \(4032\), choice \(\mathrm{D}\).
methods.levelReason: The solution uses the absolute-value rule and subtraction of negative integers.
